title: Hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam (2026)
description: What a centre or school in Vietnam must do to employ a foreign English teacher: work permit, documents, timing, pay, fines and the Decree 393 change.
h1: Hiring a foreign English teacher in Vietnam: the rules, the work permit and the process
intro: To hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam, the employer must get the teacher a work permit before work starts and file 60 to 10 days ahead. In Ho Chi Minh City, the Department of Home Affairs publishes a decision time of 5 working days. Decree 219/2025/ND-CP sets the rules until Decree 393/2026/ND-CP replaces it on 5 December 2026. Under Decree 283/2026/ND-CP, a company that employs a teacher without a permit pays twice the fine set for an individual.
keyPoints: The employer applies for the work permit, not the teacher. File between **60 and 10 days** before the start date. Decree 219/2025/ND-CP allows 10 working days for a decision, and Ho Chi Minh City publishes 5.

Teachers are filed as **experts**. That means a bachelor's degree plus at least 2 years' relevant experience, or proof of the qualification standard set by education law. Settle which proof you will file before you make an offer.
Announce the post to Vietnamese workers **at least 5 days before filing**. Sign a written labour contract before the start date.

Employing a teacher without a permit costs an organisation {{vnd:60000000-90000000}} for 1–10 workers under Decree 283/2026/ND-CP. Filing forged or altered documents costs an organisation {{vnd:80000000-120000000}}.
**Decree 393/2026/ND-CP takes effect on 5 December 2026.** Permits already issued stay valid until they expire, and employers must report every six months, before 5 June and 5 December.

sections.title: How do you hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam?

blocks.text: You choose a candidate who meets the work-permit test, announce the post to Vietnamese workers, collect the teacher's documents and file a work permit application before the teacher starts. The **work permit** (giấy phép lao động) is the document that lets a foreign national work for your organisation. The provincial authority issues it to you as the employer. Without it, or a confirmed exemption, the teacher may not work, even part-time or on probation.

In Ho Chi Minh City, permits for employers outside export-processing zones, industrial parks and high-tech parks are issued by the **Department of Home Affairs (Sở Nội vụ)**. That covers practically every language centre and school. The city confirmed this in [Decision 6093/QĐ-UBND of 21 September 2026](https://luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/quyet-dinh-6093-qd-ubnd-tp-ho-chi-minh-2026-cong-bo-danh-muc-thu-tuc-hanh-chinh-sua-doi-bo-sung-448197-d2.html). Employers inside the zones file with the management board for their zone, [as Dân trí reported](https://dantri.com.vn/lao-dong-viec-lam/tphcm-giao-4-co-quan-giai-quyet-thu-tuc-cap-phep-lao-dong-nuoc-ngoai-20260926183114135.htm).

items.title: Check the candidate against the expert test
items.text: Under [Decree 219/2025/ND-CP](https://luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/nghi-dinh-219-2025-nd-cp-quy-dinh-ve-nguoi-lao-dong-nuoc-ngoai-tai-viet-nam-407607-d1.html) Art 3(3)(a), an expert has a bachelor's degree or higher plus at least 2 years of relevant experience. Art 19(3) also accepts, for education, documents showing the teacher meets the qualification standard set by education law. Decide which proof you will file, and tell the candidate in writing before they commit.

items.title: Announce the post to Vietnamese workers
items.text: The demand explanation (Form 03 under Decree 219) states that you announced the job to Vietnamese workers **at least 5 days before filing** and could not fill it.

items.title: Collect and prepare the documents
items.text: Get the criminal record, health certificate, degree and experience proof together, authenticated and translated. See the documents list below.

items.title: File 60 to 10 days before the start date
items.text: Under Decree 219 Art 22(1), file with the Department of Home Affairs (or your zone's board) no earlier than 60 days and no later than 10 days before the teacher's first working day.

items.title: Wait for the decision and pay the fee
items.text: Decree 219 allows 10 working days from a complete file, and the city publishes 5. A refusal must come in writing within 3 working days.

items.title: Sign the written labour contract
items.text: Decree 219 Art 22(4) requires a written labour contract signed before the expected start date, with a copy sent to the authority on request.

items.title: Keep up the duties after hiring
items.text: Notify the authority of changes on time, recover the permit when the job ends, and apply for any extension before the permit runs out.

blocks.text: Once the work permit is issued, the rest of the teacher's paperwork follows. The Department of Home Affairs or your adviser can tell you exactly what your organisation must do and what it costs. The issuing authority always has the final word on any file.

sections.title: What documents does a foreign English teacher in Vietnam need for the work permit?

blocks.text: The file pairs your demand explanation with the teacher's personal documents. The list below comes from Decree 219 Art 18 and the [national public service portal](https://vpcp.dichvucong.gov.vn/p/home/dvc-chi-tiet-thu-tuc-dung-chung.html?ma_thu_tuc=1.014199). Ask the Department of Home Affairs before you file, because the portal notes that the list varies with the case.

blocks.caption: Work permit file for an English teacher, as set by Decree 219/2025/ND-CP (read 10 November 2026)
rows: States that the post was announced to Vietnamese workers at least 5 days before filing
Issued no more than **6 months** before filing
A foreign one counts only under a mutual-recognition agreement and is valid for 12 months, so in practice the check is done in Vietnam
A copy, as the authority asks
Degree plus proof of years of experience, or education-law qualification proof
Usually the labour contract or offer

blocks.text: Foreign degrees and records must be authenticated for use in Vietnam and translated. The teacher-side guides cover the detail: [degree and document authentication](/teach-in-vietnam/getting-your-degree-authenticated-for-vietnam) and the [criminal record check](/teach-in-vietnam/criminal-record-check-for-a-vietnam-work-permit). Expect those steps, not the permit decision, to set your timetable.

blocks.title: Experience letters must be true
blocks.text: Some candidates have under 2 years' experience. How Ho Chi Minh City applies the education-law proof in Art 19(3)(đ) to them is not published, so ask the Department of Home Affairs before you promise a start date. Never file an experience letter that is not true. Under [Decree 283/2026/ND-CP](https://luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/nghi-dinh-283-2026-nd-cp-xu-phat-vi-pham-hanh-chinh-lao-dong-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-440485-d1.html) Art 13(4), altered or forged documents are fined {{vnd:40000000-60000000}} for an individual and twice that for an organisation. A case can also be referred for criminal investigation.
Does the teacher need a TEFL certificate?

A TEFL, TESOL or CELTA does not replace the degree in the work-permit test. On its own, it does not replace the experience either. It is the education-side requirement. LuatVietnam has summarised a Ministry of Education reply on [Circular 21/2018 for language centres](https://luatvietnam.vn/linh-vuc-khac/trung-tam-ngoai-ngu-thue-giao-vien-nuoc-ngoai-can-dieu-kien-gi-883-100926-article.html). According to that summary, English teachers need a language-teaching certificate accredited or recognised by a reputable international body, such as TESOL, TEFL or CELTA. The law sets no minimum number of hours.

sections.title: How long does hiring a teacher in Vietnam take?

blocks.text: The permit decision itself is quick. According to Ho Chi Minh City's Decision 6093/QĐ-UBND (September 2026), the Department of Home Affairs decides within 5 working days of a complete file. Gathering documents from abroad is what takes weeks, so plan backwards from the first lesson.

blocks.caption: Work permit timing in Ho Chi Minh City under Decree 219/2025/ND-CP and Decision 6093/QĐ-UBND, as of November 2026
rows: 10 to 45 days before expiry; once only, for up to 2 years

blocks.text: Keep the 6-month criminal record limit in view. If authentication or translation drags on, the record can go stale before you file and the teacher will need a new one.

sections.title: How much do English teachers in Vietnam get paid?

blocks.text: Most centres pay by the hour, while full-time public-school and IELTS roles are often paid by the month. Among the Ho Chi Minh City teaching ads on [eno.vn's jobs page](/jobs-vietnam-expats) on 10 November 2026, hourly offers ran {{vnd:450000-550000}}. Most of those ads did not state pay at all.

blocks.caption: Pay stated in Ho Chi Minh City English-teaching ads listed on eno.vn, read 10 November 2026
rows: Language centre, English, maths and science
Education company, ESL, maths and science
Public school through an agency, hourly
Public school through an agency, full-time

blocks.text: An advertised rate is a ceiling more often than a promise, and candidates compare the hours, the paid prep and the contract length. The teacher-side view is in [English teacher salary in Vietnam](/teach-in-vietnam/english-teacher-salary-in-vietnam). Set pay by the role, not the passport. Pay that differs by nationality is the subject of [hiring bias in teaching jobs](/teach-in-vietnam/discrimination-and-hiring-bias-in-teaching-jobs-in-vietnam).

On top of pay, the employer pays the city's permit fee. According to AZV Law (May 2026, updated August 2026), the fee in Ho Chi Minh City is {{vnd:600000}} for a new permit. The city People's Council sets the fee, so confirm the current amount with the Department of Home Affairs. Tax and insurance follow the contract. The teacher-side rules are in [social and health insurance for foreign teachers](/teach-in-vietnam/social-and-health-insurance-for-foreign-teachers-in-vietnam).

sections.title: What are the fines for employing a foreign teacher without a work permit in Vietnam?

blocks.text: Decree 283/2026/ND-CP has fined both sides since 10 September 2026. The employer pays per band of workers, and the teacher pays separately and may be deported. The amounts in [Article 13](https://luatvietnam.vn/lao-dong/nghi-dinh-283-2026-nd-cp-xu-phat-vi-pham-hanh-chinh-lao-dong-bao-hiem-xa-hoi-440485-d1.html) apply to individuals. Under Article 7, an organisation, which most centres and schools are, pays twice those amounts, [as Vietnam Briefing sets out](https://www.vietnam-briefing.com/news/vietnam-foreign-worker-penalties-under-decree-283.html/).

blocks.caption: Fines under Decree 283/2026/ND-CP Article 13, in force since 10 September 2026
rows: Employing 1–10 foreign workers without a permit
Employing 21 or more without a permit
Altered or forged documents in the file
Work outside the permit's terms, or a permit not recovered

blocks.text: The teacher who works without a permit, or on an expired one, is fined {{vnd:15000000-25000000}} and may be deported. The most common way to break the rules is a teacher who starts on a trial or short contract "while the permit is processed". Under Decree 219, the start date comes after the permit, not before.

sections.title: What changes for employers on 5 December 2026?

blocks.text: Decree 393/2026/ND-CP, issued on 20 October 2026, replaces Decree 219/2025/ND-CP from 5 December 2026. Work permits already issued under Decree 219 stay valid until they expire. This summary comes from the [Dong Nai Department of Home Affairs (23 October 2026)](https://snv.dongnai.gov.vn/vi/news/thong-tin-chi-dao-dieu-hanh/nhung-diem-moi-cua-nghi-dinh-so-393-2026-nd-cp-ve-quy-dinh-nguoi-lao-dong-nuoc-ngoai-lam-viec-tai-viet-nam-352.html) and [LuatVietnam (6 November 2026)](https://luatvietnam.vn/linh-vuc-khac/diem-moi-nghi-dinh-393-2026-nd-cp-ve-lao-dong-nuoc-ngoai-tai-viet-nam-883-115274-article.html). Both are summaries, so check the decree text before you rely on a detail.

items: **Experts:** the general test stays a degree plus at least 2 years' relevant experience. New routes are added, including experts in teaching, research and academic exchange at educational institutions, and anyone with at least 5 years' relevant experience. The criteria for the teaching route had not been spelled out in those summaries.

**Extensions:** processing drops from 10 to 5 working days. File at least 10 working days and no more than 90 days before expiry. No health certificate or recruitment notice is needed for an extension.
**Reporting:** employers report on their foreign workers twice a year, before 5 June and 5 December.
**No leasing out:** an employer may not lease a foreign worker to another organisation.
**Fewer papers:** a criminal record or passport copy is not needed where the authority can pull the data from national databases.

blocks.text: Neither summary says how a file lodged before 5 December 2026 but decided afterwards is handled. If your start date falls around then, ask the Department of Home Affairs which decree it will apply, and file early in the 60-day window.

sections.title: Where can you find English teachers in Vietnam?

blocks.text: eno.vn is a free classifieds marketplace for expats and locals in Vietnam. Two parts of it serve employers: [teacher profiles](/c/teachers), where teachers describe what they teach, and [free job posts](/post). Neither one replaces your own checks or the permit file.
Teacher profiles

A teacher profile is free and public. It shows the subjects and ages the teacher teaches, their experience, where they live and can teach, and their qualifications as typed information. Profiles hold no uploaded documents, so check the originals before you file. Profiles created since 18 October 2026 carry an intro video, which the teacher can keep private and send on request.

Any signed-in account can message teachers, up to a daily number of new teachers: 3 for an unverified account, 10 once your identity is verified and 30 for a verified business. You can send at most two messages until the teacher replies. The teacher sees whether you are a verified business. A teacher's phone number, email and CV stay hidden until the teacher taps Share in your chat.

For short-notice gaps, business accounts can request cover lessons. Teachers mark their free mornings, afternoons and evenings, an hourly rate and the districts they will travel to, such as District 1, Binh Thanh or District 7 (Phu My Hung). Since July 2025, official addresses use new ward names rather than districts. The terms are covered in [cover lessons and substitute teaching](/teach-in-vietnam/cover-lessons-and-substitute-teaching-in-ho-chi-minh-city).
Posting a job free

An employer can post a teaching job directly on eno.vn free. Candidates message you in the app after signing in, and eno.vn does not handle the applications. Posts are not verified by eno.vn, so state the pay, the hours and who files the work permit. Clear ads attract teachers who know the rules. The [school directory](/schools) lists 172 Ho Chi Minh City employers, where teachers who worked or interviewed there can vote and leave reviews. Most schools have few or no reviews yet.

faqs.q: How do I hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam?
faqs.a: To hire a foreign English teacher in Vietnam, the employer picks a candidate who meets the expert test and announces the post to Vietnamese workers at least 5 days before filing. The employer then gathers the teacher's documents and files a work permit application 60 to 10 days before the start date. In Ho Chi Minh City, centres outside industrial and high-tech zones file with the Department of Home Affairs, which publishes a 5-working-day decision time.

faqs.q: Can a language centre in Vietnam employ an English teacher without a work permit?
faqs.a: No. A language centre in Vietnam may not employ a foreign English teacher without a work permit or a confirmed exemption. Under Decree 283/2026/ND-CP, in force since 10 September 2026, the employer is fined by the number of workers involved, and organisations pay twice the individual rate. The teacher is fined separately and may be deported. Altered or forged documents in the file carry a heavier fine and can be referred for criminal investigation.

faqs.q: How long does a work permit for an English teacher in Vietnam take?
faqs.a: A work permit for an English teacher in Vietnam takes up to 10 working days under Decree 219/2025/ND-CP. Ho Chi Minh City publishes 5 working days for the Department of Home Affairs, counted from a complete file. Gathering documents takes far longer, because the criminal record, degree authentication and translations can take weeks. The employer must file between 60 and 10 days before the teacher's start date.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to hire an English teacher in Vietnam?
faqs.a: The main cost of hiring an English teacher in Vietnam is pay. Most Ho Chi Minh City language centres advertise an hourly rate, while full-time public-school and IELTS roles are often paid by the month. The pay table on this page gives the figures from ads on eno.vn on 10 November 2026. The employer also pays Ho Chi Minh City's work permit fee, and statutory insurance contributions where the contract requires them.

faqs.q: Does an English teacher in Vietnam need a TEFL certificate?
faqs.a: Vietnam's work permit test does not ask for a TEFL certificate. An expert needs a degree plus at least 2 years' relevant experience, or proof of the qualification standard set by education law. A TEFL, TESOL or CELTA is the education-side requirement. According to a Ministry of Education reply summarised by LuatVietnam, English teachers at language centres need a teaching certificate accredited or recognised by a reputable international body. The law sets no minimum number of hours.

faqs.q: What changes for employers of foreign teachers in Vietnam on 5 December 2026?
faqs.a: Decree 393/2026/ND-CP replaces Decree 219/2025/ND-CP on 5 December 2026, and permits already issued stay valid until they expire. According to the Dong Nai Department of Home Affairs (October 2026), the new decree adds a route for teaching experts and cuts extension processing to 5 working days. It also bans leasing foreign workers out and requires reports before 5 June and 5 December. How files lodged before 5 December are handled is unpublished.

faqs.q: Where can I find English teachers in Vietnam?
faqs.a: Employers can find English teachers in Vietnam through eno.vn teacher profiles. The profiles are free and public, showing subjects, ages taught, experience, the areas a teacher works in and qualifications typed by the teacher. Any signed-in account can message teachers within daily limits, and business accounts can request cover lessons. An employer can also post a teaching job on eno.vn free. Profiles hold no documents, so check originals before filing a work permit.
